title: TradeCraft - Player Market & Server Economy
description: Simple player economy with Micro currency and markets
body:
# TradeCraft - Player Market & Server Economy 💰

If you're looking for a **simple, lightweight, and practical economy system** for your Minecraft server, **TradeCraft** is built exactly for that.

TradeCraft introduces a small but powerful currency called **Micro**, designed to make trading between players smooth and natural without relying on complicated commands or oversized economy plugins.

When a player joins the server for the first time, they automatically receive **500 Micro** as a starting balance. This currency becomes the core of the server’s economy and can be used for trading, payments, and player-run markets.

One of the best parts is that **your money never disappears when you die**. No matter what happens in the world, your Micro balance stays safe. The goal of this mod is to encourage trading and player interaction, not punish mistakes.

---

## 💳 Simple Currency System

Your **Micro balance is always visible on the HUD**, displayed clearly near the hotbar so you can easily keep track of your money while playing.

No constant commands.
No menus to dig through.

Just a clean and simple display that keeps the economy part of the game without getting in the way.

---

## 🤝 Player-to-Player Trading

Trading with other players is quick and straightforward.

Simply **look at another player and press the "I" key**, and they will receive a trade request directly in chat.

They can choose:

✔ Accept
✖ Decline

If they accept, a small trading interface opens where players can **transfer Micro between each other**.

There are no item trades in this system — it's purely a **currency transfer** to keep everything clear and prevent trade scams.

Fast, simple, and perfect for quick payments.

---

## 📦 Market Chest – Player Shops

The biggest feature of TradeCraft is the **Market Chest**.

This special chest-like block allows players to create their own **automatic shops** directly in the world.

Players can configure the chest to **sell items** to others or **buy items** from other players.

---

### 🛒 Sell Mode

In Sell Mode, you place items in the Market Chest and set a price.

Example:

5 Diamonds
Price: 100 Micro

When another player purchases the item:

• The item is removed from the chest
• The buyer receives the item
• The seller receives the Micro payment

Even if the seller is **offline**, the money will still be delivered automatically.

This allows players to run shops that work **24/7**.

---

### 📥 Buy Orders

Players can also create **buy requests**.

Example:

Buying: 10 Iron
Reward: 50 Micro

If another player sells the requested item:

• The item is removed from the seller's inventory
• The seller receives the Micro payment
• The shop owner receives the item

For safety and inventory handling, the **shop owner must be online** to receive items from buy orders.

---

## 🔒 Shop Protection

Every Market Chest belongs to its owner.

Other players cannot:

* Change its settings
* Steal items from it
* Break it

Your shop stays completely secure.

---

## ⚡ Lightweight & Server Friendly

TradeCraft was designed with performance in mind.

It avoids complex systems and focuses only on the features that matter most for multiplayer servers:

• Player currency
• Safe trading
• Player-run shops

No unnecessary mechanics.
No heavy systems.

Just a clean and efficient economy system that fits naturally into Minecraft gameplay.

---

## 🌍 Perfect For Multiplayer Servers

TradeCraft is ideal for servers that want:

• A simple economy
• Player markets
• Easy money transfers
• A natural trading experience

Whether you're running a **small survival server with friends** or building a larger community, TradeCraft gives players the tools they need to create their own economy.

And the best part?

It all stays **simple, lightweight, and fun**.
